verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local model runtime with desktop and mobile apps, so a unified model, prompt and config manager is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows a fetch script for downloading models, auto-detected tiers from config.json, and CLI flags to swap or disable adapters. Those are adjacent building blocks: nothing documents a single place to manage downloaded models, saved prompts, or per-model configurations.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place
